tone.target: bright pop-punk crunch with chorus sheen
tone.profile: bright pop-punk crunch with chorus sheen
tone.summary: A bright, crunchy pop-punk tone achieved using a Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe), boosted with an OD pedal for edge-of-breakup grit, and enhanced with Chorus and light Digital Delay.
corrections: lean more into crunchy drive than clean
